en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑storey, U‑shaped barracks building surrounding a bare yard. The structure has a tiled roof with several chimneys and a continuous arcade on both levels, with arched openings. Leafless trees and a simple wooden structure stand in the yard, and a few people are visible. At the lower left of the image side the word "Pécs" is printed, and at the lower right "Fejérváry laktanya" is printed. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, an address area, a green Hungarian postage stamp, and a circular postal cancellation.
